prompt:
Create ONE polished brand design comparison board, landscape 1536x1024 style, for an original AI agent experiment platform called AgentLabyrinth. This is a preview concept board, not final production vector assets. Design three DISTINCT animal-based product marks in three clean equal vertical columns on a flat warm ivory #F8F6F1 background. High end graphic identity exploration, flat vector-like shapes, strong silhouettes and very few details, elegant editorial spacing, no gradients, no texture, no shadows, no 3D, no stock icons, no copying existing brands.

Header exact text "AgentLabyrinth" with small subheading "Animal identity concepts". Each column has a small A/B/C label and animal name, one very large mark, a small rounded-square app icon using EXACT same mark silhouette, a single-color mark, and a tiny navigation size sample. Bottom caption exact text "Explore. Act. Verify." Consistent terracotta #C96442 and dark terracotta #A6492D, charcoal #2D2B27, cream white. Small examples must reuse the same mark, not redesign.

A / RACCOON — recommended direction. A clever alert raccoon with a distinctive dark facial mask, rounded ears, short snout, small almond eyes, and a curved ringed tail that integrates one simple angular maze/path bend in negative space. Compact balanced asymmetrical silhouette, curious but professional, subtle lively character. The tail and mask should be bold enough for a small app icon; not a full realistic animal illustration. Do not overload with circuits, node dots, badges or decorative sparkles. Aim for a memorable, original iconic animal, not a generic bear face.

B / FOX — sleek alert fox in a compact curled silhouette, triangular ears, angular snout and a sweeping broad tail which creates a simple open passage in its negative space. Distinct from Firefox: no globe, no flame circle, no multicolor gradient. More agile angular personality, refined friendly expression. Two-color maximum.

C / OCTOPUS — a curious intelligent octopus, round domed head with two restrained eyes, simplified bold curled arms combined into a compact emblem. One arm ends in a subtle directional curve to suggest controlled tool use. Broad filled silhouette, clear rhythm, no busy circuitry or eight separate detailed tools, not a robot.

No Chinese text, no charts or data, no screenshots, no photographic assets. This should feel like three plausible refined identity proposals for a developer's research workbench. More individuality than generic AI sparkle logos, avoid childish sticker mascots. All columns must have equally large marks, generous negative space, crisp typography, and precisely consistent color usage.
